headline: US government bans DeepSeek models for federal civilian agencies
summary: The US Department of Homeland Security ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products, potentially deterring broader US enterprise adoption.
why: Government restrictions on foreign artificial intelligence models shape competitive dynamics and compliance standards across the domestic tech sector.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Geopolitical bans on specific AI tools shift enterprise software procurement preferences toward domestic providers.
